description: This file defines the ClientEntity class implementing OAuth2 client interface, including properties and setter methods related to OAuth2 client details within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\API\OAuth2\Entities\ClientEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 client entity with properties for client name, redirect URI, and confidentiality status, implementing the ClientEntityInterface.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OAuth2 client.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the OAuth2 client.

methods.name: setIsConfidential
methods.description: Sets whether the client is confidential.
